title: review follow-ups of PR #37931: ADR-0057 still describes the retired Studio copilot, a build dock key the code no longer uses, and a plan marker nothing produces
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① L1/L2 follow-ups of one PR (`review follow-ups of PR #N`, one card per PR, later rounds append here). Source: fleet (author's Acceptance notes on PR #37931 for card #37855, "stale ADR text seen and left untouched"; seat record 7218028007 item 5).
Grading: area:ux · Task · p3 · domain:ui. Prose only, `ui/docs/adr/**` (governed, Tier H).
Reader: seat repo:objectstack#3, zone o3-ux, after PR #37931 merges (same file).
Dedupe: `"ADR-0057"` open hits are #37855 (A5, the PR above), the #37853 topic and its C3/T-cards; none revises A2/A3 text.

Business reason: ADR-0057 is what the AI drawer's implementation cards (C4 #37860, C5 #37861) are built from. Three sentences describe things that are gone, so a developer following them builds for a Studio copilot that no longer exists or looks for a dock key the code no longer writes.

## Items
- [ ] F1: A3 "One container" (`ui/docs/adr/0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md` ~:483 at 43ce73118d) still names Studio's copilot, which left with objectstack#37720.
- [ ] F2: A2's `app:PKG:build` dock key (~:402, :411, :421) no longer matches the code; read the current key and record it, or mark the bullet superseded.
- [ ] F3: A3 "Entry" (~:495) names a plan marker that nothing produces since #37720 retired the build chat (no pending plan is published to the assistant bus).
Each as an in-place dated mark in the ADR's own `*(Amended …)*` form; no ruling changes.
